miabi.details:
Operations note: TLS incident
Symptom: a certificate error blocked builds, which go through the built-in registry served by Goma Gateway.
What I did: I deleted the certificates by hand inside the Goma Gateway container.
Outcome: they regenerated on their own and builds started working again.
I didn’t identify the original cause. My PRs are on the web console, not the Go backend.

operate.title: Operate
operate.heading: Unblock things when they break.
operate.body: Managing applications also means fixing them. The note below covers a blockage on the registry the builds depend on.

design.incident_caveat: I haven’t confirmed the original cause. This note describes what I saw and what I did.

symptom.title: 01 / Symptom
symptom.body: A TLS certificate error blocked builds. They go through Miabi’s built-in registry, served by Goma Gateway.

intervention.title: 02 / What I did
intervention.body: I deleted the certificates by hand inside the Goma Gateway container.

result.title: 03 / Outcome
result.body: The certificates regenerated automatically and builds started working again.
